title: Takanas HaShavin Simanim 14–15 — Source-accurate reconciliation of 20 quotation-format conflicts
scope: Part 2 reader notes only; no change to Simanim 1–13, Siman 10 audit, manuscripts, or KDP
decisionRule: Where a previously published literal quote-delimiter operation targets source text replaced by a newer audited, shorter source quote or carefully qualified paraphrase, do not insert obsolete punctuation into text that does not contain that quote. Use the source-checked wording and provenance in the later audit. Keep the old full witness as archival evidence. Do not conflate disputed witnesses, later commentators, and Rav Tzadok’s own inferences.
